source: Bitstamp BTC/USD public hourly OHLC, existing verified local cache
quality: 24 consecutive hourly bars, each with positive traded volume; exclude a day containing an exact Jie transition from directional attribution

outcomes.upBias: upExcursionPct > downExcursionPct; equality is neither direction
outcomes.downBias: downExcursionPct > upExcursionPct; equality is neither direction
outcomes.highFirst: every hour attaining the daily high precedes every hour attaining the daily low
outcomes.lowFirst: every hour attaining the daily low precedes every hour attaining the daily high
outcomes.ambiguousOrder: otherwise, including extremes in the same hour or interleaving ties

dayRules.stem_metal_water_up: day stem in 庚辛壬癸; favorable outcomes upBias and lowFirst
dayRules.stem_fire_down: day stem in 丙丁; favorable outcomes downBias and highFirst
dayRules.branch_yin_down: day branch 寅; favorable outcomes downBias and highFirst
dayRules.gengxu_down: day pillar 庚戌; favorable outcomes downBias and highFirst

control: For each rule compare trigger dates with non-trigger dates in the same calendar year and exact solar-month episode; weight each control stratum by its trigger count; unmatched trigger dates are excluded from comparison and counted
monthView: Show all 12 solar-month branches separately; never pool all metal or water months into one selected result
jieNear: Civil dates within 2 days of any exact Jie instant, excluding the transition date itself; compare with farther eligible dates in the same year and exact solar-month episode
interpretation: Retrospective descriptive audit after outcomes were seen; no optimized threshold, trading return or prospective accuracy claim
